tests: Initial views render; home has goal-first composer, three task rows and collapsed examples
Invalid headless desktop and controller routes refuse admission
Composer input survives navigation and escapes injected text
Editable plan preserves scope, links adjacent validation errors and resets dialog scroll between steps
Locked Mac blocks desktop but permits reviewed scoped file tasks
Approval expiry blocks action, fresh review permits exactly one approval
Deny preserves downloadable local notes and cannot later approve stale request
Offline work queues, reconnect pauses, explicit resume starts
Takeover fences desktop work; handback leaves task paused until explicit resume
Stop all blocks task admission, old approvals and resurrection; reconnect acknowledges stop
Stopping release cancels pending approval without global stop
Pairing checks identity, gives no access and derives path for each OS
Completed task has outcome before timeline; local download filenames and MIME type match
Same-view renders preserve open disclosures and repeated action focus; route changes reset disclosures
Toast is visible, escaped task titles render as text, and search routes correctly
Downloaded Blob bytes contain synthetic artifact text and valid simulation activity JSON
method: Temporary Node VM with a mock document; source closure exposed only in memory. Simulated DOM replacements exercise disclosure/focus logic; synthetic download Blob bytes are inspected.
limitations: This harness does not verify browser rendering, native focus behavior or native event ordering. Browser checks are recorded separately.
Mock DOM assertions verify requested insertion position and ARIA links, not visual placement or screen-reader announcements.
No real devices, backend, network, credential or security controls are tested.
